title: studio(interfaces): the nav rail draws a separator item as an unlabeled disabled row and ignores badge
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → showcase → Interfaces: the `nav_sep_reports` entry (`type: 'separator'`) shows in the rail as a greyed, unlabeled row with a generic icon; *Hours by Status*' `badge: 'NEW'` is not shown.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

The running app's sidebar draws the separator as a divider and the badge as a pill; Studio's rail does not, so the design surface disagrees with the app it designs.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`NavTree` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has branches for groups and leaves only; `resolveSurface` returns `null` for `separator`, which renders as a disabled button.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Draw `separator` as a divider and render `badge` / `badgeVariant` like the runtime sidebar.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.
